read_language_file: read an ASE language file and parse entities with their parameters into a list of tuples
read_trajectory_file: read a ground truth trajectory CSV file and return device poses and timestamps
read_points_file: read a semidense point cloud file and return world positions as a numpy array
parse_trajectory_line: parse a single ground truth trajectory CSV line into a pose with timestamp and SE3 transform
summarize_readers_module: summarize the ASE readers module functions for loading language files, trajectories, and point clouds
